shortDescription: The CAC 40 Index dropped 67 points or 0.81 percent on Monday to close at 8113 points.Losses were led by Legrand (-6.82%), Schneider Electric (-6.81%) and STMicroelectronics (-6.18%).Offsetting the fall, top gainers were Capgemini (6.61%), Dassault Systemes (4.99%) and TP (4.11%).

children: The CAC 40 Index dropped 67 points or 0.81 percent on Monday to close at 8113 points.
Losses were led by Legrand (-6.82%), Schneider Electric (-6.81%) and STMicroelectronics (-6.18%).
Offsetting the fall, top gainers were Capgemini (6.61%), Dassault Systemes (4.99%) and TP (4.11%).

title: The CAC 40 Index Closes 0.81% Lower
